about: Commit 382fa96, "Adding a Self-Audit run on each issue branch to the session instructions": one file at the root, so the commit summary sits directly above the file summary.

true_document.summary: Adds a Self-Audit step to the working loop in CLAUDE.md, before a PR is marked ready, and a Self-Audit section on how to start the GitHub run, read its findings, and fix or rebut each one.

files.summary: Adds to the working loop a step to run Self-Audit on the branch and fix or rebut each finding before marking the PR ready, and adds a Self-Audit section: GitHub audits klint/ with Jev and the repository secret; the session starts the run, waits for it, reads both audits' findings in the log, checks each against the code, fixes each valid one, rebuts each one that is not valid in a PR comment, and records the run and the rebuttal in the PR.

hunks.summary: Adds step 6 to the working loop, to run Self-Audit on the branch before marking the PR ready and fix or rebut each finding, so that commenting on the issue at every stop becomes step 7.

Adds a "Self-Audit" section: GitHub audits klint/ with Jev and the repository secret, on the issue branch before a PR is marked ready and on epic-67 before it goes to main, so the key never reaches the session. The session starts and watches the run with gh, reads the findings of both audits in the log, checks each against the code without changing code only because it was flagged, fixes each valid finding, rebuts each invalid one in a PR comment, and records the run and the rebuttal in the PR. A run fails only when an audit cannot run, and a branch cut from epic-67 before e1cb0a6 is rebased before it is started by hand.

planted_mistakes.summary: Adds step 6 to the working loop, to run Self-Audit on the branch after the PR is merged and fix or rebut each finding, so that commenting on the issue at every stop becomes step 7.
planted_mistakes.why_wrong: The step runs Self-Audit before marking the PR ready.

planted_mistakes.summary: Adds a Self-Audit section on starting the GitHub run and handling its findings.
